records.name: Mese del Gusto (Garda Trentino)
records.venue: various / Riva del Garda & Garda Trentino
records.descriptionDe: Regionale Genussveranstaltungen im Garda Trentino: dezentraler Festivalzeitraum mit Märkten, Degustationen und lokalen Themenveranstaltungen (25.09.–08.11.2026).
records.descriptionEn: Autumn food festival across Garda Trentino (25 Sep–8 Nov 2026): markets, tastings and themed local food events with venues in Riva del Garda, Arco, Torbole and surrounding valleys.
records.descriptionIt: Rassegna enogastronomica diffusa nel Garda Trentino (25/09–08/11/2026): mercati, degustazioni e appuntamenti dedicati ai prodotti locali con eventi anche a Riva del Garda.
records.organizer: APT Garda Dolomiti / Garda Dolomiti S.p.A.

records.name: Sponde — Pesce d'acqua dolce in tavola (parte di Mese del Gusto)
records.venue: Via Maffei / Palazzo Martini (Riva del Garda) - specific venues vary by program
records.descriptionDe: Ein Tag mit dem Schwerpunkt Süßwasserfischküche im Rahmen des Mese del Gusto – Verkostungen, Street food und besondere Menüs (25.09.2026, Riva del Garda).
records.descriptionEn: One-day program focused on freshwater fish cuisine within Mese del Gusto: tastings, street-food and special menus in Riva del Garda (25 Sep 2026).
records.descriptionIt: Appuntamento dedicato al pesce d’acqua dolce all'interno del Mese del Gusto: degustazioni e proposte gastronomiche a Riva del Garda (25/09/2026).

records.name: Rock Master — Arco (40th edition)
records.venue: Rock Master Climbing Stadium, Via dei Legionari Cecoslovacchi 26
records.descriptionDe: Internationales Kletter-Event (Rock Master) mit Wettkämpfen, Talks und Rahmenprogramm im Climbing Stadium von Arco (2.–4.10.2026).
records.descriptionEn: Rock Master international climbing event with competitions, talks and public activities at the Arco Climbing Stadium (2–4 Oct 2026).
records.descriptionIt: Evento internazionale di arrampicata Rock Master con gare, incontri e attività pubbliche al Climbing Stadium di Arco (2–4 ottobre 2026).
records.organizer: Rock Master organisation in partnership with Comune di Arco / Apt Garda Dolomiti
records.price: many activities free; tickets/registration for some competitions (see organizer)

records.name: Mercatini di Natale di Arco (Christmas Market)
records.venue: Centro storico di Arco (piazze e vie, incl. Piazzale Segantini)
records.descriptionDe: Weihnachtsmarkt im historischen Zentrum von Arco mit rund 40 Holzhütten, Lichtern, Handwerk und Familienprogramm (13.11.2026–06.01.2027).
records.descriptionEn: Christmas market in Arco historic centre with ~40 wooden stalls, lights, artisan products and family activities (13 Nov 2026–6 Jan 2027).
records.descriptionIt: Mercatino di Natale nel centro storico di Arco con circa 40 casette in legno, installazioni luminose, spettacoli e attività per famiglie (13/11/2026–06/01/2027).
records.organizer: Mercatini di Natale di Arco / Assocentro (organizzazione locale)
records.price: free entry (individual activities may have fees)

records.name: Expo Riva Schuh & Gardabags (106° edition)
records.descriptionDe: Internationale Fachmesse für Volumen-Schuhmode und Lederwaren in Riva del Garda (16.–19.01.2027).
records.descriptionEn: International trade fair for volume footwear and leather goods in Riva del Garda (16–19 Jan 2027).
records.descriptionIt: Fiera internazionale dedicata alla calzatura di volume e alla pelletteria a Riva del Garda (16–19 gennaio 2027).
records.organizer: Riva del Garda Fierecongressi S.p.A. (Expo Riva Schuh)
records.price: professional trade fair — registration/ticket required for exhibitors/visitors

records.name: Trento Film Festival (75th edition)
records.venue: various cinemas and venues in Trento
records.descriptionDe: Internationales Filmfestival zur Bergwelt, Exploration und Umwelt — zahlreiche Filmprogramme und Events (24.04.–02.05.2027).
records.descriptionEn: International mountain and exploration film festival with film screenings, meetings and exhibitions across Trento (24 Apr–2 May 2027).
records.descriptionIt: Rassegna internazionale di cinema di montagna e esplorazione con proiezioni, incontri e mostre a Trento (24 aprile–2 maggio 2027).

records.name: EDUCA — Festival dell'educazione (Rovereto)
records.descriptionDe: Festival der Bildung mit Treffen, Workshops und Konzerten rund um Erziehung, Schule und Wohlbefinden (25.–27.09.2026, Rovereto).
records.descriptionEn: Education festival with talks, labs and performances on schooling, wellbeing and community (25–27 Sep 2026) held in multiple Rovereto venues.
records.descriptionIt: Festival dell'educazione con incontri, laboratori e spettacoli su scuola, benessere e comunità (25–27 settembre 2026) in varie sedi di Rovereto.
records.organizer: Consolida in collaborazione con Provincia autonoma di Trento e partner locali
records.price: many free sessions; some ticketed activities
